Key verdict: this round is useful internal evidence but not a clean comparative benchmark. Repo architecture audit, flow explanation, and bounded refactor plan stayed meaningfully anchored across lanes. Feature location, bug triage, safe change plan, small feature patch, seeded bug fix, code review diff, and docs drift were underanchored enough that the self-scores are visibly inflated relative to shared-task comparability. Treat arm deltas as exploratory only, not public-claim material.
